title: Generalized spectral distance
formal_object: A=E[(q-c_pos)(q-c_pos)^T]+rho I SPD; B=E[(q-c_neg)(q-c_neg)^T] PSD; k-dimensional metric M=VV^T.
assumptions: rho>0; moments use only released fitting positives and explicit negatives.
Generalized eigenvectors are A-orthonormal, V^T A V=I_k.
Scientific score is negative Mahalanobis squared distance; bilinear similarity is a separate construction.

operations.output: C=A^-1/2 B A^-1/2 is symmetric PSD.

operations.input: Rayleigh trace with V^T A V=I_k
operations.output: Top eigenvectors of C maximize tr(V^T B V).

derivation_steps.statement: Bv=eta A v and V=A^-1/2 U_top.
derivation_steps.justification: Lagrange differentiation plus whitening converts the generalized problem to symmetric eigenvectors.

derivation_steps.statement: -(q-c)^T M(q-c)=2 q^T M c-c^T M c-q^T M q.
derivation_steps.justification: Expand the quadratic; only the query term is constant across candidates.

derivation_steps.statement: Ranking by q^T M c is generally different unless c^T M c is constant over that query's candidate list.
derivation_steps.justification: M is low-rank anisotropic; original unit Euclidean norms do not imply equal M norms. This is an algebraic boundary, not a measured benchmark outcome.

method_expression: Construct V from the generalized spectrum and rank all released candidates by negative metric distance if implementing this child derivation.
distinguishing_prediction: Any discrepancy between raw bilinear and distance rankings is driven by candidate metric-norm variation; the corrected distance need not improve hit@1.
falsifier: Equal norm-corrected and bilinear rankings remove the mismatch for that scope. White covariance or supervised metric baselines matching the quality/cost defeat a new-method claim.
closest_alternative: Existing supervised Mahalanobis/LDA metric learning and whitening; full primary functional comparison still missing.
decisive_comparison: Native-only comparison between distance, legacy bilinear and same-rank whitening with identical training/PCA; a score change needs a reviewed child protocol.
legacy_code_audit: Legacy fit(I03) creates M correctly for the spectral optimization but run_method/features uses bilinear qMc and omits candidate norm. Historical code is retained and not certified against this revised distance card.
review_limit: Central derivation audited, actual code discrepancy retained; no automatic result repair or retroactive certification.
